title: Mean Flows for One-step Generative Modeling
tldr_zh: 用平均速度场替代瞬时速度，MeanFlow identity 从头训练一步生成，ImageNet-256 1-NFE FID 3.43
tldr_en: MeanFlow models average velocity fields via a derived identity, enabling from-scratch 1-NFE generation with ImageNet-256 FID 3.43

key_numbers.description: ImageNet 256×256 1-NFE FID, MeanFlow-XL/2, 676M params, 240 epochs, from scratch
Shortcut-XL/2 1-NFE FID, previous SOTA in 1-NFE class
IMM-XL/2 one-step FID (1×2 NFE with CFG)
1-NFE FID when r=t always (reduces to standard Flow Matching)
1-NFE FID with 25% r≠t ratio, ViT-B/4, 80 epochs
CIFAR-10 unconditional 1-NFE FID, MeanFlow, no preconditioner
JAX implementation overhead of JVP relative to total training time, upper bound
Best 1-NFE FID with CFG scale ω=3.0, ViT-B/4, 80 epochs
